description.value: The study investigated neural correlates of impaired cognitive control during a Stroop task in individuals with methamphetamine dependence compared with healthy controls, and examined relationships between brain activation, performance, drug-use characteristics, and impulsivity.

design.value: A cross-sectional case-control fMRI study compared 18 individuals with methamphetamine dependence with 21 healthy controls during congruent and incongruent Stroop conditions, using group, condition, and age in an ANCOVA design and conducting behavioral and correlational analyses.

description.value: The M.I.N.I. interview was used by trained study personnel to establish methamphetamine dependence according to DSM-IV criteria and to assess psychiatric exclusion criteria.

clinical_characteristics.value: MA abusers reported MA consumption for approximately 15.3 years (SD = 6.1) on average, with a mean age of 17.8 years (SD = 4.0) when beginning the first MA consumption. Crystal meth was administered mostly intranasally and approximately on 16.9 days out of the last 30 days.

medication_status.value: At the time of measurement, methamphetamine abstinence existed for an average of 8.3 ± 6.4 days.

task_name.value: manual version of the Stroop test

task_description.value: The task consisted of two conditions: a congruent condition (CC) and an incongruent condition (IC). In the CC, 18 color words were presented in the color denoted by the corresponding word; in the IC, 18 color words were displayed in one of three colors that were not denoted by the word. Two possible answers were presented, and participants indicated the type of color by pressing one of two buttons.

presentation_software.value: Presentation software (Neurobehavioral Systems Inc., Albany, California) running on a PC connected to a video projector

instructions.value: All subjects were instructed to indicate as fast as possible the type of color by pressing one of two buttons with the right index or middle finger.

stimuli.value: Color words presented in congruent or incongruent colors; two possible answers in black type were presented in the lower visual field. Stimulus presentation time was 1500 ms with an interstimulus interval of 10.5 s, and temporal jitter was introduced.

task_description.value: A resting-state fMRI was acquired to investigate putatively altered functional connectivity; it was not reported here.

instrument.value: MAGNETOM PRISMA FIT, Siemens Healthineers, Erlangen, Germany, equipped with a 64-element head matrix coil

description.value: A series of 220 whole-brain volume sets was acquired in one session during the Stroop task. T2*-weighted images were obtained using a multiband multislice GE-EPI sequence with 104 contiguous transverse slices covering the entire brain and including the lower brainstem.

description.value: A resting-state fMRI was acquired after the structural T1 image and before the Stroop test to investigate putatively altered functional connectivity; details were not reported here.

Functional images were slice-time corrected, corrected for head motion, co-registered to the T1 reference using boundary-based registration, normalized to MNI space using nonlinear registration, spatially smoothed with a 6 mm FWHM Gaussian kernel, and the first four images were discarded.

steps.value: Functional images were slice-time corrected using 3dTshift from AFNI.
Functional images were corrected for head motion.
The structural T1 image was adjusted for intensity non-uniformity.
Non-brain tissue was removed from the structural T1 image.
Functional images were co-registered to the T1 reference using bbregister, which implements boundary-based registration.
T1 images were normalized to MNI space by applying nonlinear registration using ANTs version 2.2.0.
The derived transformation parameters were used to normalize the functional images.
Functional images were spatially smoothed with a Gaussian kernel of 6 mm FWHM using mcflirt (FSL 5.0.9).
The first four images were discarded.

model_settings.value: The data were high-pass filtered with a cutoff period of 128 s, corrected for serial correlations by choosing AR(1), and analyzed voxel-wise within the general linear model to calculate statistical parametric maps of t statistics for condition-specific effects.

A between-subjects factor group (MA vs HC), a within-subjects factor task (CC vs IC), and age as a covariate were included. Whole-brain group comparisons were thresholded at voxel-level p < 0.001 uncorrected with minimum cluster size k ≥ 16; clusters were also evaluated using FWE correction at p < 0.05.
One between-subjects factor group (MA vs HC) and one within-subjects factor condition (CC vs IC) were used for reaction time.
Group differences in the number of correct responses were analyzed non-parametrically.

Spearman correlations were calculated between Stroop accuracy and mean parameter estimates from significant clusters, and between those parameter estimates and duration of drug consumption, age of starting crystal meth consumption, and the UPPS total score.
